criteria.evidence: src/hooks/useFilteredProducts.ts lines 19-28 apply all three filters (term, category, inStockOnly) to `result` before any sort. Sort occurs at lines 30-36. criteria.description: Sorting must not mutate the products array held in ProductContext. The implementation must create a copy of the array before sorting.
criteria.evidence: Line 18 of useFilteredProducts.ts: `let result: Product[] = [...products];` creates a spread copy. All subsequent `.sort()` calls (lines 31, 33, 35) operate on `result`, not on `products`. No bare `products.sort(...)` call exists in the file. Hidden mutation tests passed as part of the full test run: 21 passed (21).

criteria.description: All five values consumed inside the useMemo — products, debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly, and sortBy — must appear in the dependency array.
criteria.evidence: Line 39 of useFilteredProducts.ts reads: `}, [products, debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly, sortBy]);` — all five dependencies are present.
